name: Lustre
summary: Warm ivory hair and beauty studio site with a condensed Instrument Serif voice, italic cocoa second lines, arch-topped photo cards and frosted glass captions.

fonts.pairing: condensed high-contrast serif for headlines with an italic second line, neutral sans for body, wide-tracked uppercase labels

signature: headlines split into an upright line and an italic cocoa line
photo cards with one large rounded top-left corner (asymmetric arch) and a frosted glass caption panel inset at the bottom
giant faint serif word set behind the testimonial card
imagery: warm salon interiors with brass mirrors, close-up hair colour and styling shots, soft amber light
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, about 24px side padding, 60px section padding on a cream page, 3-column service grid, 24px card radius with a 120px corner on one side
